description: This file defines a Water class for rendering water effects in Unity, including reflection and refraction handling, camera setup, and shader configuration.

classes.name: Water
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour class that manages water rendering, including reflection and refraction effects, camera setup, and shader configuration.

methods.name: OnWillRenderObject
methods.description: Handles rendering reflections and refractions when the water object is about to be rendered.

methods.name: OnDisable
methods.description: Cleans up reflection and refraction textures and cameras when the object is disabled.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates water shader parameters for wave scrolling effects.

methods.name: UpdateCameraModes
methods.description: Synchronizes camera settings between source and destination cameras.

methods.name: CreateWaterObjects
methods.description: Creates reflection and refraction cameras and textures as needed.

methods.name: GetWaterMode
methods.description: Determines the effective water mode based on hardware support and settings.

methods.name: FindHardwareWaterSupport
methods.description: Detects hardware support for water effects based on material tags.

methods.name: CameraSpacePlane
methods.description: Calculates a plane in camera space for reflection and refraction calculations.

methods.name: CalculateReflectionMatrix
methods.description: Computes a reflection matrix around a given plane.
